architecture_summary.pattern: Deterministic State Machine with Exact Checkpoint Injection & Anti-Fake Command Receipt Matching
responsibilities: Orchestrate 19-scene playback against 975,000 ms timeline with integer millisecond precision
Inject verified code fragments from checkpoints cp_00 to cp_09 without querying live LLMs
Simulate realistic keystroke velocity across typing modes (instant, fast, normal, slow, custom cps)
Replay verified terminal receipts and enforce strict SCRIPT_RUNTIME_MISMATCH rejection on assertion failures
Support instant fast-forward and recovery through resume_from(scene_id, action_id)
Guarantee reproducible composite hashes across multiple execution runs for video capture acceptance

typing_simulation.interpolation: linear timecode character reveal with cursor tracking

terminal_playback.anti_fake_policy: Strict verification of exit codes, pass count assertions, and output substrings
